entities.name: Junzo Inohara
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Junzo Inohara  was a Japanese field hockey player who competed in the 1932 Summer Olympics. In 1932 he was a member of the Japanese field hockey team, which won the silver medal. He played two matches as forward. He was born in Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan.
